edits.new: The seeding set and the harness environment: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0444; ASM-0636). The harness pack is agreed at the wave 4 entry check, owner role Integration lead: the SIT hosts per hop, the cutover extract fixture with its keys and the orphan plan_ref as named fields, the SCR-45 composite route path and break-list fields, the extract format and the report retention, and the seeding set, which is stub-served on Day 1 and replaced hop by hop as RWB-P1-DM004-APP lands. The gate passes only on one break row per orphan and equal counts across a rerun (GAP-0444). The live treatment rows load into rwb_treatment through rwb-treatment: RWB-P1-DM004-APP extracts and maps the legacy treatment and approval records and reads v_ace_plan, and the DP04 copies are built from events, not from the extract (GAP-0523). The plan link carried is v_ace_plan.plan_ref, read only; the one-off cutover read lands nothing in rwb_source_data, and its format is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0524).
